layers.label: Elevation
layers.description: Real LOLA elevation; area-mean display layer from the 80 m product. Not a landing-safety metric.
layers.source: NASA PGDA 90 / LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ.TIF / Barker et al. (2023)

layers.label: Slope
layers.description: Real LOLA slope; area-mean display layer from the 80 m product. Not a landing-safety metric.
layers.source: NASA PGDA 90 / LDSM_80S_80MPP_ADJ.TIF / Barker et al. (2023)

layers.label: Permanent shadow
layers.description: Mapped permanently shadowed regions (cold traps, possible ice); a pixel is PSR if at least half of its 20 m source cells are.
layers.source: NASA PGDA LOLA 20 m PSR mask, LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/data/LOLA_20mpp/LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF); Barker et al. (2023); majority (>=50 %) reduction to 512² in python/export/layers.py

layers.label: Sunlight
layers.description: Share of 2027 with the Sun above a flat local horizon (no terrain shadowing yet).
layers.source: python/export/grids.py → grid/south_5km.bin (SPICE DE440, flat horizon, 2027 hourly), metric illum_pct; window 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z to 2028-01-01T00:00:00Z

layers.label: Earth visibility
layers.description: Share of 2027 with Earth above a flat horizon + 2° antenna margin.
layers.source: python/export/grids.py → grid/south_5km.bin (SPICE DE440, flat horizon, 2027 hourly), metric earth_vis_pct; window 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z to 2028-01-01T00:00:00Z
